notes.title: Demo Timer Removed – You Asked, We Listened!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The demo timer is gone. For good.[/b][/h2][p]A lot of players asked for it, and we totally get it — a timer in a board game doesn’t exactly scream "chill time with your friends" So we went back, looked at the feedback, and said "screw that"[/p][p]No more countdown. No more pressure. You can try [i]Board Game Society[/i] as much as you like, whenever you like. Whether you're solo testing mechanics or pulling a friend in for a match, it's all fully available, no strings attached.[/p][p]So feel free to explore the board, find little secrets, and experience an early snippet of what's to come. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thanks for all the feedback, now give us even more![/b][/h2][p]We’re incredibly grateful for everyone who took the time to play and share their thoughts. It really helps shape where we go next. And to make it even easier, we've added a [b]FEEDBACK[/b] button in the pause menu, while playing the game so you can quickly and easily give us your feedback on the go. [/p][p][/p][p]Give it another go if you’ve been waiting — or tell a friend that the time limit’s no longer a thing.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this with us.
[b]– The Jetebra Games team[/b][/p]
